title: Russian Tofu Croquettes
description: A delicious and crispy deep-fried snack made with tofu and Russian-inspired flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oil for frying to 180°C (350°F).
Crush the tofu into a crumbly texture and mix with Russian sausage, grated oozy cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and mix with milk.
Combine the egg mixture with the tofu mixture and stir well.
Add the bread crumbs and mix until a dough forms.
Shape the dough into small cylinders and coat with all-purpose flour.
Heat the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Fry the croquettes until golden brown and crispy.
Drain excess oil on paper towels and serve hot.
